page_title: AUS 3-1 JOR | Austria v Jordan 17/06/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+13' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+12' 3 - 1 Goal! Marko Arnautovic (Austria) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Yazeed Abulaila into left side of the goal.
90+12' Marko Arnautovic (Austria) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
90+12' The Austria players are happy as the referee awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!
90+10' There's a break in play and referee Dahane Beida must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Austria using VAR. This could be interesting!
90+9' Saleem Obaid (Jordan) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the ref turns down the penalty appeals and waves play on!

90+9' Marko Arnautovic (Austria) received a pass inside the box and sent a dangerous shot in on goal, but keep the champagne on ice as one of the defenders stepped in and blocked the effort. It's hard to say whether the keeper would have stopped it.
90+4' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Marcel Sabitzer (Austria), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
90+3' That was close. Ali Azaizeh (Jordan) fires a shot from the edge of the box which goes a whisker wide of the right post.
90+2' Stefan Posch (Austria) tackles a bit over-zealously and Dahane Beida blows for a foul.

90+2' Yazeed Abulaila makes a sensational save to thwart a great chance. A rebound falls to Marko Arnautovic (Austria) inside the box and he strikes goalwards, but the ball ends up in the keeper's gloves instead of the left side of the target.
90' The fourth official shows 10 min. of added time.
89' Stefan Posch (Austria) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
89' Jamal Sellami has decided to substitute Odeh Al Fakhouri and he is replaced by Ali Azaizeh (Jordan).
88' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Mohammad Al Daoud (Jordan) replaces Mousa Tamari.
87' Odeh Al Fakhouri (Jordan) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
87' Stefan Posch (Austria) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
86' The attendance is 68527.
84' Ali Olwan (Jordan) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
83' Substitution. Patrick Wimmer (Austria) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Romano Schmid walks off.
81' Here is a change. Ehsan Haddad is going off and Jamal Sellami gives the last tactical orders to Mahmoud Al Mardi (Jordan).
81' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Saed Al Rosan is coming onto the pitch as Abdallah Nasib (Jordan) cannot continue after picking up an injury.
80' Marko Arnautovic (Austria) is caught offside!
77' Marcel Sabitzer (Austria) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
76' 2 - 1 It's an own goal! An unlucky moment for Yazan Al Arab (Jordan), who heads the corner kick behind his own keeper. The score is 2:1.
76' Marcel Sabitzer (Austria) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
72' The referee blows his whistle and players are going to refresh themselves.
72' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Saleem Obaid (Jordan) comes onto the pitch so that Mo Abualnadi can be given a rest.
72' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for Austria due to a handball in the build-up play.
69' The Austria players halt their celebrations as referee Dahane Beida makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was a handball in the build-up play.
67' Goal 2:1! Marko Arnautovic (Austria) taps home from close range after the rebound fell kindly into his path.
67' Marcel Sabitzer (Austria) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
66' Mousa Tamari (Jordan) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
65' Yazeed Abulaila (Jordan) is able to continue to play.
63' The game is interrupted now, Yazeed Abulaila (Jordan) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
63' Carney Chukwuemeka (Austria) shoots inside the box, but is denied by a timely block.
60' The ball sits up nicely on the edge of the box for Stefan Posch (Austria), but his powerful first-time effort flies high over the bar.
59' Today's match ends for Phillipp Mwene who will be replaced by Paul Wanner (Austria).
59' Substitution. David Alaba leaves the pitch and is replaced by Kevin Danso (Austria).
59' Ralf Rangnick prepares a substitution. Xaver Schlager is replaced by Carney Chukwuemeka (Austria).
58' Mousa Tamari (Jordan) brings his opponent down. Dahane Beida has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
56' A pass from Ehsan Haddad (Jordan) is intercepted by Alexander Schlager and the move breaks down.
55' Ali Olwan (Jordan) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked.
50' 1 - 1 GOAL! Ali Olwan (Jordan) got to the ball in front of the goal and he couldn't miss from there. His strike went in off the right-hand post. The score is 1:1.
46' Odeh Al Fakhouri (Jordan) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Alexander Schlager, who smothers the ball.
46' The game is over for Sasa Kalajdzic. Marko Arnautovic (Austria) comes on for the second half.
46' The second half has just started.
45+5' Dahane Beida has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+4' Sasa Kalajdzic (Austria) rushes a shot from long range and subsequently sends it high over the bar.
45+3' The ball is cleared after Mousa Tamari (Jordan) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
45+1' Mousa Tamari (Jordan) skips perfectly past challenges but misdirects his shot from the edge of the box. The ball flies a few yards wide of the right post.
45' We will have 4 min. of added time.
45' Ehsan Haddad (Jordan) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
44' Mousa Tamari (Jordan) unleashes a missile of a shot towards goal, but his good effort is blocked by one of the defenders.
43' Dahane Beida has a clear sight and sees a foul from Stefan Posch (Austria).
43' Mohannad Abu Taha (Jordan) takes the corner.
41' A player from Austria commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
40' Dahane Beida blows his whistle after Nizar Al Rashdan (Jordan) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
35' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 5:6.
34' Mousa Tamari (Jordan) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked.

34' Ali Olwan (Jordan) beats the defender inside the box and lashes a shot towards the right side of the goal, but Alexander Schlager makes a brilliant reflex save to deny him. Goalkeeping at its best!
32' Konrad Laimer (Austria) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
29' Phillipp Mwene (Austria) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
23' A cooling break is underway.
22' What a chance that is! Ali Olwan (Jordan) leaps high to meet a lofted pass inside the six-yard box, but his header crashes off the crossbar!
22' Jordan take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
21' 1 - 0 Romano Schmid (Austria) takes a great first touch to control a killer pass on the edge of the box and curls the ball into the top right corner in trademark fashion.
19' Austria are ruled offside.
18' Odeh Al Fakhouri (Jordan) works the corner short.
17' Odeh Al Fakhouri (Jordan) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. A brilliant save by Alexander Schlager stops the ball from going into the top of the net.
16' Marcel Sabitzer (Austria) takes the corner with a short pass.
14' Dahane Beida blows his whistle and signals a foul after Xaver Schlager (Austria) brought his opponent down.
13' Abdallah Nasib (Jordan) jumps into a tackle and Dahane Beida signals a foul.
12' Konrad Laimer (Austria) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
11' David Alaba (Austria) tries his luck with and strikes the ball towards goal from long-range, but it is blocked by one of the defenders.
10' Xaver Schlager (Austria) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
7' The game is interrupted, a clear handball by Konrad Laimer (Austria).
7' Konrad Laimer (Austria) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
5' Ali Olwan (Jordan) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
2' The defence just can't clear the ball and a rebound eventually falls to Ehsan Haddad (Jordan) deep inside the box, but his well-hit shot flies just wide of the right post.
